source: porting specification section 7.6, standalone synthetic golden vectors
conventions: A sequence of bytes is a hex string in serialized order, without a 0x prefix.
A single word is a hex string of its value, most significant nibble first, as the specification writes it.
Everything a decoder produces is a JSON number.
Approximate decimal values may be checked within float_tolerance before the specified binary32 conversion.

dtra8.description: Packed translation: three signed high words plus a packed word of per-component fractions and an exponent.

dsca8.description: Packed scale, in the same shape as DTRA8.

drot3.description: Three-byte smallest-three rotation. Every case shares one premise: a signed high word of 0x2000 with the low five bits zero, so the stored component is 0.5 and its companion is sqrt(3)/2.
drot3.refusing_codes_note: Code 7 has no golden result and must refuse.

bvm_compact.description: Compact integers: six payload bits in the first byte, whose top two bits select how many little-endian bytes follow. Signed values sign-extend at the encoded width.

uv0.description: Unified UV0: one packed word and a scale index produce a UV pair.

packed_z_cross_word.description: Reading a bit field that straddles two words. The low-order result bit is the first serialized bit read.

compressed_anim_channel.description: Pins the selector-plus-changeStart value indexing: two animated channels, one change sample.

hierarchy_composition.description: A parent and one child local transform compose to a world transform.

visibility_sentinels.description: Selector sentinels decide visibility, and a clip that omits a node does not overwrite the setup value.

scenarios.name: hidden parent hides a locally active child
a clip containing the parent with SCAI 0xFFFF reveals both
a clip omitting the parent retains the hidden setup value

bilinear_resize.description: The only operation permitted to interpolate. Single-band source in row order.

one_texel_gutter.description: A byte-exact operation. Distinguishes repeating colour from clamped alpha in the same gutter, which is why the two layouts differ.

gain_offset.description: Colour gain and offset, rounded half to even and clipped. Alpha never participates.
